221170101.text: Oh, please tell me I didn't leave it at the top of the mountain...

221170102.text: Hey granny, fancy meeting you here.

221170103.text: Well! Fancy running into you youngsters at a place like this! What are the chances... But, you should have put on more layers, you know. It's windy up there, you'll catch a cold.

221170104.text: I was just on my way back to the city from Mt. Hulao. I went up there to see an old friend of mine, and we had a delightful chat about the old times.

221170105.text: But halfway back, I've suddenly realized I've forgotten something. *sigh* I must have left it up on the mountain...

221170106.text: At my age, I don't think I could make it all the way up there a second time in one day... It's such a long distance, and there's all that bothersome amber up there.

221170107.text: Youngsters... Could you fetch it back from the mountain top for me? I'd be ever so grateful...

221170109.text: You know, the one who lives on Mt. Hulao. You must have met him. That amber of his is a real nuisance...

221170110.text: My memory must be going. Honestly, how could I forget to put the box in my teapot before I left...

221170112.text: A box... I think. My memory is not what it once was... Why didn't I just put it in my teapot straight away? Would've saved me so much hassle.

221170113.text: At least if it is up in the mountains, the chances are it will have become trapped in amber. So finding it once you're up there shouldn't be too difficult.

221170114.text: Youngsters, please make a poor old lady's day. Fetch it back from Mt. Hulao for me, would you? The part where all that amber is.

221170115.text: Mind yourselves, though. Who knows what else might be encased in amber after all these years...

subQuests.subQuestName: Smash the amber and find Madame Ping's box

221170201.text: This looks like the thing granny wanted.

221170301.text: Silly child, why ever didn't you wrap up warm before you came out? I'd feel terrible if you were to catch a cold.

221170302.text: Hi granny, is this what you lost?

221170303.text: Let me take a look... Ah yes, that's it. So I did leave it up there, after all. My memory is so hopeless these days...

221170304.text: I'll take it now, thank you. All it contains is a few old bits and bobs anyway.

221170305.text: These, on the other hand, are for you. Thank you dears.

221170306.text: Now to put this box in my teapot before I forget...

221170401.text: Silly child, why ever didn't you wrap up warm before you came out? I'd feel terrible if you were to catch a cold.

221170403.text: My old friend makes it. He says it catches monsters and bandits on their way up the mountain.

221170404.text: It's been around a very long time indeed. Honestly, that amber has trapped some very peculiar things over the years...

221170405.text: It really is a ghastly substance...

221170407.text: Oh, it's spick and span once again now. All thanks to you, of course!

221170408.text: In fact, the whole reason I came all this way to collect that thing was to spruce up my teapot a little further.

221170409.text: Once it's both spick and span and in tip-top condition, I'll finally be able to treat my guests to tea again...
